mapper.select: select ssl.*, NVL(ck_stat.ck_play_count, 0) as ck_play_count, NVL(ck_stat.ck_win_count, 0) as ck_win_count, NVL(ck_stat.ck_lose_count, 0) as ck_lose_count, NVL(ck_stat.ck_win_rate, 0) as ck_win_rate, NVL(cs.current_streak, 0) as current_streak, cs.current_result as current_result from streamer_stat_list ssl left join (select cp.ck_streamer as streamer_no, count(*) as ck_play_count, sum(case when c.ck_winner = cp.ck_side THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ck_win_count, sum(case when c.ck_winner <> cp.ck_side THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ck_lose_count, round(sum(case when c.ck_winner = cp.ck_side THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)* 100,1) as ck_win_rate from ck_participant cp join ck c on c.ck_id = cp.ck_id where cp.ck_streamer = #{streamerNo} group by cp.ck_streamer) ck_stat ON ck_stat.streamer_no = ssl.streamer_no left join ck_streak cs on cs.streamer_no = ssl.streamer_no where ssl.streamer_no = #{streamerNo}
select count(*) from streamer where streamer_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
select * from streamer where lower(streamer_name) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' or lower(streamer_soop_id) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%'
